import itertools

def is_valid(p):
    n = len(p)
    diffs = [abs(p[i+1] - p[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
    return sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, n))

def solve():
    # x[0]=0, x[3]=8, d[1]=8
    # d[1] = |x[2] - x[1]| = 8
    # x[0]=0
    # x[1] can be anything from 1-9
    # x[2] = x[1] +/- 8
    # Since x[1], x[2] in 0-9, x[1] must be 1 or 9.
    # If x[1]=1, x[2]=9. Then d[0]=|1-0|=1, d[1]=|9-1|=8, d[2]=|8-9|=1. (Invalid, d[0]=d[2])
    # If x[1]=9, x[2]=1. Then d[0]=|9-0|=9, d[1]=|1-9|=8, d[2]=|8-1|=7. (Valid)
    
    # So x[0]=0, x[1]=9, x[2]=1, x[3]=8
    
    fixed = [0, 9, 1, 8]
    remaining = [i for i in range(10) if i not in fixed]
    
    for p_rem in itertools.permutations(remaining):
        p = fixed + list(p_rem)
        if is_valid(p):
            return p
    return None

print(solve())
